definitions.gloss: rhythmical; rhythmic; having a regular beat
definitions.explanation: Having a pleasing, regular pattern of movement or sound; characterized by rhythm.

examples.japanese: リズミカルな⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧リズミカル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}いた→叩く：02072_tataku⟧。
リズミカルな⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: Doing exercises with rhythmic movements is fun.

notes:
リズミカル is a loanword from the English "rhythmical." It is used as a na-adjective to describe things that have a pleasing, regular beat or pattern.

USAGE:
As a na-adjective: リズミカルな + noun (rhythmic ~) or リズミカル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (rhythmically). Often used to describe music, movement, speech patterns, and work pace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- リズミカルな⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: rhythmic performance
- リズミカルな⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧: rhythmic movement
- リズミカル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: walk rhythmically
- リズミカルな⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧: conversation with a good rhythm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧: rhythm — the noun form (also a loanword)
- ⟦テンポ→テンポ：04749_tenpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: having good tempo — describes a pleasing pace
- ⟦{軽快|けいかい}→軽快：09190_keikai⟧な: light and brisk — similar feel but emphasizes lightness and speed
